history.name: Assistant

Thanks. Provisional criteria for “not currently on the library’s shelves” typically includes statuses like Checked Out, In Transit, On Hold shelf (held aside for a patron, not in open stacks), In Processing (not yet shelved), Repair, and Lost. On Shelf means on the shelves.

WebSurfer, please confirm that including On Hold shelf, In Processing, Repair, Lost as not-on-shelf matches common public library conventions.

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content:
Checked references from multiple public library catalogs and documentation. General conventions:
- Available/On Shelf: on shelves and accessible.
- Checked Out/On Loan: not on shelves.
- In Transit: between locations, not on shelves.
- On Hold shelf: pulled and held for a patron; not in general shelves.
- In Processing/In Repair: undergoing work; not on shelves.
- Lost/Missing: not on shelves.
So counting those as off-shelf is consistent with common practice.
